WHAT WE OFFER / SERVICES BRANDING + DESIGN

what we offer.

From building brands from the ground up to helping existing ones evolve, we offer creative support across identity, packaging, campaigns and everything in between.

Brand identity

Logo systems, typography, colour, visual language, art direction and brand guidelines built to give your business a clear, recognisable point of view.

Packaging

Packaging concepts, artwork and systems designed to carry the identity into the real world — from product ranges to limited editions and launches.

Campaigns

Campaign concepts and brand rollout across print, POS, menus, social assets, launch collateral and the everyday touchpoints your audience actually sees.

Ongoing design support

Reserved creative support for brands and agencies that need a reliable design partner to keep work moving, consistent and on-brand month after month.

WHAT WE BELIEVE THE LINDLEY LAB APPROACH

Lindley Lab represents experimentation, exploration, questioning what already exists and creating what doesn’t.

That’s how we believe great design should work. We want to work alongside businesses of any size that are ambitious enough to try something new, curious enough to see where an idea could go, and optimistic enough to believe in what they’re building.
